Staged drafting (as E2)
claims with evidence ids

div.style: color: rgb(29, 39, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(29, 39, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Checker call (model)
prompt: the claim + only its cited evidence
question: does the evidence support every part?
answer: supported / partly / not, with reason

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(29, 39, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(29, 39, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Option 1 · flag only
claim kept, checker verdict stored
→ U cannot change; H3 would need
another measure

div.style: color: rgb(29, 39, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Option 2 · one revision
model rewrites once with the checker's reason;
original kept in the stage log; never silent
→ U can change (H3 as written)

div.style: color: rgb(29, 39, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Deterministic verifier (same as all conditions)
grounded / weak / unsupported

SectionDraft + StageLogs
extra calls and time are reported
